about: Every Zombies weapon builder part (Parts/<Category>) is a Sandbox wrench item, generated at load from the part library (Source/Constructs/ConstructWeaponParts.cs; docs/sandbox/CONSTRUCTS.md, 'Weapon builder parts in Sandbox'). Builder parts that already have a hand-made construct part (a gunPart or gun receiver file in Constructs/Parts/Weapons) are not generated again. scale: how much bigger than the handheld part its construct model is (the hand-made construct gun parts are about twice the handheld size). creativeOnly: categories offered only on creative maps (infinite parts): the Zombies-economy parts, until the developer decides. skip: categories never generated.
